problem: A measured voice correction can choose a globally length-optimal paragraph combination that concentrates narration in a scene with too few unique relevant photographs, even when another returned combination is feasible.

change.behavior: Rank the already returned complete paragraph combinations by measured-duration estimate; before proofread/review or another TTS, select the closest combination that passes topical photo-capacity preflight. Fail before another provider call only if no returned combination is feasible.

regression.case: The global length-best variant overfills the first scene; a slightly longer alternative preserves the five-photo capacity and is selected.
